svg.title: The fused executor
svg.desc: Panel a: the stored state grows only as fused blocks touch new qubits, so a GHZ chain reaches its full size in its last block. Panel b: a dense block on non-adjacent axes is gathered chunk by chunk, multiplied in cache and written once, to a second buffer or, when two buffers do not fit, back in place.
svg.text: (B) ONE PASS OF A DENSE BLOCK ON AXES A, |A| = K
Chunks are split across the worker's threads: one read and one write of the
state per block. Measurement reads the marginal in stored order π.
When two state buffers do not fit, Y_c is written back over X_c: one buffer, peak 1.5× state.
